races.display_title: PwC Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: KIMI DE MAI went close at Roscommon last time, where a mistake at the last may have cost her victory, and, back down in trip, she is taken to open her account. Impressive Galway bumper winner Brickfield Belle is feared most, with Silk Buds also respected after making the frame in bumpers. KIMI DE MAI (FR) BRICKFIELD BELLE (IRE) SILK BUDS (IRE)

races.display_title: Irish Wire Products (C & G) Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: THINKITDONTJINXIT was runner-up in back-to-back Thurles bumpers and, despite disappointing when last seen in that sphere, looks the type to come into his own over hurdles, with Global Submission the main danger if ready to go on return and progressive maiden Approval very much respected. THINKITDONTJINXIT (IRE) GLOBAL SUBMISSION APPROVAL

races.display_title: Trigo Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict: An open-looking renewal but plenty of eyes will be on COME WHAT MAY , who couldn't have been much more impressive first time up at the Curragh just over 3 weeks ago and Aidan O'Brien's colt falls firmly into the 'could be anything' category. He can get the better of Snellen , who has been off since a below-par effort here in mid-July but is the type to bounce back. The lightly-raced Hazdann may emerge as best of the remainder. COME WHAT MAY (IRE) SNELLEN (IRE) HAZDANN (IRE)

races.verdict: A fiendishly-difficult finale to solve with cases able to be made for several. The vote goes to ZARAAHMANDO , who has made the frame 7 times this season and Andrew Slattery's 4-y-o can belatedly open his 2026 account. Bundle of Interest got closer than previously this season last time and now reunited with Billy Lee, she could provide most resistance. Bay of Dreams and the selection's stablemate Queen Aethelflaed can fight out minor honours. ZARAAHMANDO (IRE) BUNDLE OF INTEREST (IRE) BAY OF DREAMS (IRE)
